## Process

1. Read the Define handoff and classify each dependency as confirmed, open, or blocked.
2. Inspect the application environment evidence and record runtime, database, storage, staging, HTTPS, backup, and deployment capabilities.
3. If environment evidence is missing, produce an explicit verification request and do not select a final stack.
4. Select the smallest team-supported architecture that satisfies the approved scope.
5. Define authentication, roles, data model, private file handling, video handling, routes, deployment, and test seams.
6. Map the vertical slice to source components and acceptance checks.
7. Record unresolved video protection and SSO decisions separately from settled design choices.
8. Write `solution-design.md`, `environment-gate.md`, and `design-handoff.md` to the stage run folder.

## Audit

| Check | Pass Condition |
|---|---|
| Environment evidence | Runtime, database, storage, staging, and deployment facts are sourced or explicitly blocked |
| Stack decision | Any selected stack is supported by environment evidence |
| Scope traceability | Every build item maps to the approved baseline or is marked as a decision |
| Security design | Authentication, authorization, private files, secrets, and backup controls are defined |
| Vertical slice | Every slice step has a design location and test outcome |
